description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 30.08.2019 to 08.09.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content pertains to the establishment of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
